observations.INV-01: WPR already encodes runtime surface consumers and an explicit no-web-surface-by-design orphan rule, but BFR-H0/H2 must broaden this from runtime inventory to every Production Backend Capability.
observations.INV-02: Public Asset Registry and fail-closed resolver already exist. Consumer and Visible evidence is intentionally not inferred and remains BFR-H11/H15/H16 work.
observations.INV-03: Existing WPR homepage composition is composed at scene/section level rather than one section per runtime. HIGH capability and visual coverage remain successor composition work.
observations.INV-04: Runtime existence is already separated from customer availability. HOME_SCENE_CONSUMER or NONE_BY_DESIGN becomes a mandatory successor declaration.
observations.INV-05: Ask PHI OS is already question-scoped, deterministic, non-authoritative and independently deliverable; the new CKA surface must preserve that boundary rather than replace KAP.
observations.INV-06: KAP already forbids automatic Reality Journey escalation and requires explicit escalation consent after complexity gating.
observations.INV-07: GuidedAnswerContext is already temporary and non-canonical; no persistent case or Reality truth is created by Ask/guided context.
observations.INV-08: KAP forbids auto-executing all methods; MPA owns eligibility/dispatch and MCD owns canonical projection. The explicit client disclosure step remains a downstream surface requirement, not a new Method authority.
observations.INV-09: Current Ask endpoint is publicly callable without account gating and creates no persistent case. History/saved result/method execution/case persistence/journey continuity entitlement must be enforced downstream.
observations.INV-10: The Master Work freezes the no-deletion rule now. The V8 source artifact is not treated as part of this aligned main baseline, so semantic block migration evidence must be created at HPC2-W0 before Homepage removal is permitted.
